title: Jin Shares Chuseok Update, Teaches His Father to Play MapleStory
detail: September 25, 2026 — Jin greeted fans on Weverse after regaining access to his account following a phone change, sharing that he is spending Chuseok with his family for the first time in a while: "Since it is Chuseok, I am spending a wonderful time having a meal with my family." He said he is using the holiday to recover from the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg ahead of the Latin American leg opening in Bogotá on Oct 2, and posted a photo of his father playing MapleStory, joking that he had "grabbed" his father and "forcibly" taught him the game, calling the bonding session "truly enjoyable."

media.caption: Jin shares a Chuseok update with fans on Weverse, including a photo of his father playing MapleStory.
